title: betula × intermedia var. alpestris
intro: Betula × intermedia var. alpestris, commonly known as Silver Birch, is a hybrid of birch tree species, primarily found in mountainous regions. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Silver Birch include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic effects, which can help alleviate skin conditions, respiratory issues, and urinary problems. The bioactive constituents of Betula × intermedia var. alpestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
